notes:
- Closest Join can now enter or exit at the side of a curved Satin column. When exiting midway, the route follows the unfinished part of the column before the cover stitches back to the join.
- Connected Satin and Tatami branches with Edge Run underlay can share one inset perimeter. Select a member and choose Design > Routing > Toggle Branch Edge Run by Shape. The shared Edge Run and any additional support layers sew before the first cover.
